HOW TO USE THIS SECTION

A simple student workflow

1. Start from the unit page

Check the official syllabus scope and the unit topic checklist before opening the notes.

2. Use the uploaded PDF

The PDF linked from each active unit page is the current student material stored in the course repository.

3. Move to assessment support

Use the centralized Question Bank and MCQ module for the resources currently provided for assessment preparation.

4. Check the Course Information page

Use the approved handout page for COs, full syllabus, references, NPTEL links and assessment structure.
